<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def getP1():
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if lines[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(22,27)) for r in range(52,57))
start=getP1()
seen=[start]
for i in range(24):
    action(['UP'])
    s=getP1()
    seen.append(s)
    if s==start:
        print("cycle length:", i+1)
        break
else:
    print("no return within 24")
# print distinct symbols seen
uniq=[]
for s in seen:
    if s not in uniq: uniq.append(s)
print("distinct:", len(uniq))
def show(s): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row) for row in s)
for i,s in enumerate(uniq): print("sym",i, sum(map(sum,s)), "px")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
